notes.title: Working on Missions [Playtest]
notes.content: [h1]\[CHECK OUT THE FREE PLAYTEST!][/h1][p][/p][p]Hey folks! Just wanted to drop a quick update on some under-the-hood progress I’ve been making.[/p][p]I’ve started wiring them directly into the game loop with a brand new [b]mission screen for each NPC[/b]. The idea is simple:[/p][list][*][p]Each NPC you meet (like [i]The Dealer[/i], shown above) comes with their own [b]set of missions/objectives[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Complete all of their missions and you’ll [b]unlock the next NPC[/b], expanding the roster of characters you can interact with.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocking a new NPC means [b]fresh shop inventory[/b], new dialogue flavor, and of course [b]more missions[/b] to chase.[/p][/*][/list][p]This structure gives the game a [b]clear sense of progression[/b]: you’re not just collecting bananas endlessly, you’re working toward character-driven milestones. It also ties perfectly into the new EventBus system — objectives are just listeners on events like “collect X,” “unlock Y,” or “obtain Z.” That makes adding new mission types super easy without touching old code.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746928/9efddc8382fe53e895d04693519ead481586decf.png"][/img][i]Sneak peek[/i] [/p][p][/p][p]For a while, a lot of the game’s logic was hooked up through a big, centralized event manager. It worked fine early on, but as I kept adding features it started to feel like a messy switchboard — everything talking through the same tangle of wires. Adding new objectives or unlockables meant touching fragile code, and that slowed me down.[/p][p]So I ripped that out and replaced it with a new [b]EventBus system[/b]. What that means for the game:[/p][list][*][p][b]Modular objectives[/b] – I can now build new goals (like “collect 50 bananas” or “grab a rare skin”) just by hooking into the right event, without rewriting old code.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlock foundations[/b] – Characters, gear, utilities… all of these now share the same structure, so future unlocks will be way easier to add.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Room for growth[/b] – Achievements, stats, new resource types, etc. can all plug into the same event flow without bloating the core.[/p][/*][/list][p]From your perspective, this mostly means [b]faster iteration and more variety[/b]: new objectives and unlocks can be added quickly, and systems are less likely to trip over each other.[/p][p]I’ll be using this backbone to roll out more types of challenges, collectibles, and unlockables in upcoming builds. Think of it as me paving a clean road now so I can ship content faster later 🚀[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746928/7171122b470b03fab9b50f1c54526d5bdd60d38a.png"][/img][/p][p][i]For those of you curious, here's a little code preview.[/i] [/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Content
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Hope you’re all doing great and still stacking those bananas! 🍌 I wanted to take a moment to update you on what I’ve been working on behind the scenes.

[b][h1]🛒 New Shop System & Interface[/h1][/b]
The in-game shop is getting a complete overhaul! I’m redesigning the UI to make browsing and purchasing items smoother, more intuitive, and just overall better-looking. The goal is to make it easier to see what’s available, compare upgrades, and snag the best deals without any hassle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670519/2c91c824b63f5cabe70c78cf78a7830468062bcc.png[/img]

[h1][b]🎰 Gacha Revamp – New UI & Systems[/b][/h1]
The gacha system is also getting a major facelift! I’ve been experimenting with new UI designs to make it feel more dynamic and rewarding. Whether you’re rolling for fun or aiming for that rare drop, I want the experience to feel exciting and visually engaging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670519/93d352b9d1f469a8f1e79f4f38e6238a013930dd.png[/img]

🛠️ Next Steps – Beta Incoming!
Once everything is hooked back into Steam and major gameplay issues are repaired, I’ll be putting out a beta of this new version! This will be a chance for you all to try out the improved systems and provide feedback before the full release. 

Thanks for all your support, and stay tuned for more updates. Let me know what you think, and as always—happy clicking! 🍌

notes.title: Kickstarter is Live!
notes.content:
[b][h1]I need your help![/h1][/b]
It’s official, the Banana Clicker Kickstarter campaign has launched, we’ve got 30 days to hit our goal to fund the project in full. 

[b][h2][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/siphongames/banana-clicker-30]Kickstarter Here[/url][/h2][/b]
[b][h2]My Plans[/h2][/b]
Banana Clicker 3.0 is coming with new content, specifically it is the "Gacha Gear" overhaul. What does this mean? It means you'll be able to obtain gear to kit out your banana through gacha banners in-game, starting off with 3 slots: Top, Accessory, and Bottom. Gear serves two purposes, to offer you bonus stats aiding in your banana collecting empire and to customize your banana so that it's cool enough for your twitter page

Is that it? Just gear? No, a spew of other supporting features are also on there way!

[b][h3]Upcoming Features[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Dedicated In-Game achievements
[*] Banana Storm
[*] Dance Party 
[*] Day/Night Cycle 
[*] Dealer Dialogue & Lore
[*] Banana Jar 
[/list]

[h2]But why Kickstarter?[/h2]
Banana Clicker never sold many copies, so it hasn't been able to fund itself. It's also been stuck on the backburner, which has translated to it's seeming abandonment as a project. The Kickstarter is here to fund the complete overhaul and ability to commit to Banana Clicker as a continuous development.

[h2]What if the Kickstarter Fails?[/h2]
Version 3.0 is already in development, with regular updates on our [url=https://www.instagram.com/siphongames/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/eCZVgrJe8N]Discord[/url]! If the Kickstarter is not successful I will still be releasing the update, however at a later date and with less content.

[h1]Kickstarter Backer Rewards[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670519/78f533e96b64cc59273f79458d91ad583c275839.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670519/d2c47660ccd0751ae70c04d4a3f0b421649d230a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670519/f7674783d9c2207e76e8628c8df81438ca813f80.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670519/6a5d30f78e56ceb405c7ea7bac41f880b89477e7.png[/img]

[h1]Kickstarter Stretch Goals[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670519/38dd6f2a9b8935d3e7b9b161735062fdae1e9f98.png[/img]

[h2]What if I can't support the Kickstarter?[/h2]
I totally understand! Other ways you can support me and the development of Banana Clicker is by wishlisting if you don't already own the game, following our Instagram, and/or joining our Discord to be part of the community!

Thank you all for your support and I hope we can work together to make Banana Clicker great

notes.title: 🍌 BANANA CLICKER 3.0 – Going to Kickstarter
notes.content:
[h2]To the old fans and the newcomers![/h2]
Hey everyone! Big news, this project has been on an up and down rollercoaster, what started off as a buggy pixel art idler in 2023 went through a visual overhaul for version 2.0 in 2024

After that, the project died down yet again, but I've always wanted Banana Clicker to meet a certain standard and fill the void of quality idle games. Contrary to popular belief it has not been abandoned, so we're back again, pivoting from the rushed concept of version 2.0-but I need your help this time to make the vision come to life! 

I will be running a Kickstarter campaign to fund the full release of Banana Clicker, and posting all development progress up on the [url=https://www.instagram.com/siphongames/]Siphon Games Instagram[/url] account, along with our [url=https://discord.gg/HTkJDBgq]discord server![/url]

[h1]Please follow the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/siphongames/banana-clicker-30]Kickstarter[/url], to be notified when the campaign begins in March![/h1]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/siphongames/banana-clicker-30][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670519/149493fbcffbc7e208a78ebec0c8bfb78ee960d8.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Sneak Peak at some of the new content[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670519/7d7e6f9626f82e6af68bfcde9a0c49931ebe46ea.png[/img]
[i]Item Sets for your bananas, like version 1.0 but new and improved[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670519/5f3dbeff3bb4ec2df3830d1dd08e6c660ee258b5.png[/img]
[i]The Dealer is here is to stay, and looking better than ever![/i]

[h2]Fan Concerns[/h2]
After looking through your reviews I've noticed achievements have been a continuing issue, so for version 3.0 those will not only become a top priority but they will come with an in-game advantage.

notes.title: Banana Clicker Overhaul Update! (2024)
notes.content:
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1005634749366272124/1252379859544576010/BC_Main_Capsule.png?ex=66720122&is=6670afa2&hm=7f5ff5ecb341a7a1fe2fd7b5df49582b6eca6edd05cd920ccb5e39e6102cba6b&=&format=webp&quality=lossless[/img]

[h1]Total Game Revamp[/h1]
The long-awaited Banana Clicker overhaul is finally here! We've been hard at work to bring you a complete visual and balance rework, along with a new community feature where you get to put the paintbrush to your banana and let your creativity flow!

[h1]Noteworthy Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] When you close the game, our bananas stay the same! Groundbreaking feature, we know. 
[*] A background fully featured with more than one color! Oh my.
[*] Customized bananas in-game. We didn't want to wait to let you share your bananas, so we let you do it in the game.
[*] A total revamp of all graphics; seriously, our artist is bananas.
[*] A revamp of the gameplay features. Gear, shop, and upgrade logic improved, along with the inclusion of an in-game paint editor.
[/list]

[h1]Community Submissions[/h1]

Submit your banana creations to become the highest-ranking banana of the season and make it into the Hall of Fame, available for everyone to see!


[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1005634749366272124/1252380867922231426/Paint_ss.png?ex=66720213&is=6670b093&hm=f0ae33f81e0d5fa233f9be7b1b6616d6930a95a5dece6577c2d41bc85703cc72&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1440&height=670[/img]

We hope you enjoy your banana adventure!
